title: Object injection via Marshal.load in ruby — review required
description: Marshal.load rebuilds arbitrary Ruby objects from a byte string, including their class names and instance state. A crafted payload reaches code paths in classes the application has loaded, which is the entry point for Ruby object-injection chains. The rule flags the call; whether the bytes are trusted is a review decision.
remediation: Use JSON.parse for untrusted data, or sign the payload and verify the signature before decoding; never Marshal.load request data.
limitation: Lexical call match; reachable gadget classes depend on the loaded application.
